commit: fix(reactivity): fix dirtyLevel checks for recursive effects

truth.description: triggerEffects now skips an outdated dep entry only when effect.allowRecurse is set, but toggleRecurse turns allowRecurse off for exactly the pre-render phase in which updateComponentPreRender writes a child's new props, so a child that receives new props is left Dirty with a pending schedule and re-renders on its next computed trigger even when that computed's value did not change.

distractions.why: postCleanupEffect cuts deps down to _depsLength when each run ends, so outside a run the loop over the first _depsLength entries still visits every dep the effect holds.
